Name: Diamante
Description: Diamante SB srl, pioneers in autoimmune therapy with its novel Antigen-Specific Immunotherapy for Rheumatoid Arthritis, utilizing eco-friendly Plant-based production technology. This unique approach targets self-reactive immune cells, offering the potential to alter disease progression while preserving overall immune function, without side effects. Our model anticipates significant revenues through licensing, with an upfront payment of €15 million expected in 2026.

Name: enGenome
Description: enGenome serves molecular labs that perform genome sequencing for diagnostics. Our SaaS eVai represents a breakthrough technology for the interpretation of human genomic variations that a) has been ranked as a best-in-class tool for the diagnosis of single-gene diseases, b) can interpret variant combinations thus enabling the diagnosis of multi-gene diseases, c) is integrated with our GenAI technology to retrieve and summarize the scientific literature associated with genomic variants.

Name: Datatellers
Description: Datatellers is a consulting company specialized in Ai that helps organizations through the complex process of digital transformation. We operate primarily in biotech, Agritech and fintech fields and we are funding our own research program for AI applications in those industries. We have developed an dataplatform specialized for the integration and process automation of data coming from biotech labs.

Name: NIB biotec
Description: NIB biotec is a SME that develops in vitro diagnostic devices for prostate cancer. We aim to solve the lack of accurate diagnostic tests for all men between 40-80 years of age. We offer optimized point-of-care urine tests distinguished by high specificity, portability, low cost, real-time results. Our revenue comes from direct selling of the product to the costumers (private clinics, urologists...). Currently, we have launched two prospective studies in the Piedmont region (Italy).

Name: Profiter
Description: Profiter is an AI-powered startup optimizing stock management for the pharmaceutical sector. We prevent stockouts in hospitals and pharmacies, ensuring efficient inventory levels. Our AI-driven platform offers precise demand forecasting, serving healthcare providers with a unique, accuracy-focused solution. We operate on a subscription-based revenue model. wholesalers and a couple of pharmaceutical companies.

Name: RIC3D
Description: RIC3D S.r.l. is an innovative startup established with the mission of strengthening the healthcare sector's confidence in new technologies, thereby accelerating research and development. Founded in 2018 through the initiative of Ms. Clara Bernasco, the company aims to help provide more and better care for patients in need through the production and commercialization of innovative products or services with high technological value.

Name: medicud
Description: Medicud is a medical device startup that develops novel wound care solutions. Medicud produces Dryum, an incisional negative pressure wound therapy device that reduces from 10% to just 3% the occurrence of surgical site infection. There are more than 230 million surgical incision yearly a market value 17B€. the revenue model is a B2B with the device sold to hospitals & clinics via distributors. At the moment we completed a first in human clinical trial and have LOIs from distributors.

Name: Human Factor & Innovations
Description: HFI is a SME that develops digital solutions for health. We aim to solve following problems: a) motivation for healthy behaviors, and b) efficient/personalized care. Target customers: insurance and pharmaceutical companies and professionals. Our solutions are distinguished by a interoperable architecture (FHIR-HL7) with AI algorithms. Our revenue comes from a) savings of health insurance coverage agreements and b) royalties per visit from professionals. Currently, we are in pre-commercialization

Name: Wisepath
Description: Wisepath is a US-based start up committed to revolutionize professional development by using commercial video games and AI to bring to market the latest research in behavioral and cultural psychology. SkillQuest, our first product, is the first online training platform that accurately measures and train soft skills in a scalable, intuitive, and engaging way.

Name: Medics
Description: We are dedicated to solving the challenges faced by surgeons in achieving optimal precision and accuracy during complex procedures. Our target customers are surgeons and hospitals seeking advanced solutions for minimally invasive surgery. We offer a unique combination of hardware and software, including HA3D and ICON, that provide real-time 3D visualization and navigation, significantly improving surgical outcomes. Our revenue model is based on the sale of HA3D systems and related services. We have already gained significant traction in the market with a growing number of customers.

Name: Exosomics
Description: Exosomics has a Multi-Cancer Early Detection (MCED) spin-off project based on a proprietary (IP protected) diagnostic approach focusing on two new classes of multi-tumor protein biomarkers associated with circulating Exosomes. Cancer survival depends on  early detection. Now no MCED test is available while this is a major medical and social need. We offer a unique solution which is better performing and cheaper than competitors (Grail and Exact Sciences). Preliminary clinical data are promising.
